in_sanskrit.name: Bidhu
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Intellect, Knowledge
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Bidhu एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Bidhu is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Vidh', which means 'knowledge'. It is a name that is deeply rooted in Hindu culture and is often given to children who are believed to possess great intellect and wisdom. The name Bidhu signifies intelligence, knowledge, and understanding.
